answer: Registration binds each identity to a terrace credential: one unique hardware attestation key plus a 2,500-token bond escrowed in a shared registry. Forging one identity locks that 2,500-token bond, 100 percent slashed on detection after a 30-epoch challenge window. Splitting identities pays the full bond per key, and any shared delta penalty flags the attestation batch across independent jurors, so each fake identity costs the attacker tundra-priced stake with no discount.
